Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Hyderabad to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Project Research Scientist and Project Technical Support positions at IIT Hyderabad is 28th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: For Project Technical Support-III, an M.Sc./M.Tech. degree is required. For Project Research Scientist – Level I, a Ph.D. degree in relevant fields like Nanomedicine or Molecular Medicine is necessary.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced by IIT Hyderabad. These are divided equally, with 3 posts for Project Research Scientist – Level I and 3 posts for Project Technical Support-III.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Research Scientist – Level I position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 72,800/-, which includes HRA. This is a competitive remuneration for a research role.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application process for IIT Hyderabad recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to apply online by filling out the Google form provided in the official notification. Ensure all details are accurate and required documents are uploaded.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no mention of any application fee for applying to these project-based positions at IIT Hyderabad. Candidates should verify this in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting candidates based on their academic merit. Subsequently, shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview, which will be conducted in an online mode.

faq.question: Q8. What is the location of IIT Hyderabad?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad is located in Kandi, Sangareddy district, Telangana, with the pincode 502284.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age relaxations mentioned for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age limits or relaxation criteria for reserved categories. Candidates are advised to check the detailed advertisement for any such provisions.

faq.question: Q10. What is the tentative interview date?
faq.answer: The tentative interview date for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled for 29th September 2026. This date is subject to change, and candidates will be notified accordingly.
